country_data.feed_reference_source: US Grains & Bioproducts Council Africa Feed Price report; Botswana September 2026 country entry
country_data.feed_reference_note: National reference price for compound broiler feed, not a farm-specific delivered quotation; kept separate from the calculator's benchmark production cost.
country_data.local_feed_reference_source: Botswana Public Procurement Regulatory Authority, Price Reference Guide for Animal Feed 2025; Gaborone locality
country_data.local_feed_reference_note: Official 2025 public-procurement reference prices per 50kg bag for Gaborone. Dated feed-input references only; not current retail quotations or a complete per-bird production cost. Kept separate from calculator assumptions.
country_data.national_poultry_sector_reference_source: Business Botswana Poultry Desk, Poultry Sector Preliminary Outlook (2024 production data; preliminary sector statistics)
country_data.national_poultry_sector_reference_note: National industry context only. The report's 2024 figures are preliminary and its fieldwork initially focused on commercial/large-scale operations; reported small-producer mortality is an industry estimate. These statistics are not farm-specific production assumptions, feed conversion ratios, selling prices or complete farm budgets. They are not used to overwrite calculator inputs.
country_data.ifad_broiler_model_reference: Botswana Livestock Commercialisation Project (BoLCoP), IFAD Project Design Report No. 7326-BW, dated 22 October 2025; financial model for 400 broilers per batch, medium-scale emerging commercial farmer.
country_data.ifad_broiler_model_per_chick_placed_cost: Derived from the IFAD steady-state annual operating-input schedule (BWP49,464) plus family labour (BWP3,600), divided by 1,200 chicks placed across three 400-chick batches. Includes feed, transport, chick purchase, veterinary, utilities, brooding, miscellaneous and family labour. Excludes initial housing/equipment capital and does not resolve the model's revenue/output inconsistencies. Retained as evidence only; not used as calculator cost_per_unit.
country_data.ifad_broiler_model_output_note: The IFAD model states 400 chicks per batch, three batches annually, 5% chick/adult mortality in mature years, 10% own consumption, net production 975 birds/year, and selling price BWP85/head. Its reported revenue (BWP87,364) does not equal 975 × BWP85 (BWP82,875). The annual financial table also includes a BWP1,200 equipment replacement line in one year. Do not use model revenue to set calculator selling price or claim a verified gross margin until reconciled.
country_data.ifad_broiler_model_data_quality_note: This is a Botswana-specific, 2025 IFAD planning model for a medium-scale 400-bird unit, not an observed farm's audited accounts or a smallholder enterprise budget. It is much stronger than a generic regional proxy for cost structure, but it must remain supporting evidence until output arithmetic and live-bird selling-price assumptions are independently validated.
country_data.local_broiler_market_price_reference_sou: IFAD BoLCoP 2025 financial model, modelled selling price for a four-month broiler
country_data.local_broiler_market_price_reference_not: Modelled price assumption in a project design financial model, not an observed current transaction or current farmgate quote.

official_sector_update_2026.source: Botswana Government statements to Parliament, reported by DailyNews/BOPA
official_sector_update_2026.note: Government statement that imported raw materials can account for up to 80% of poultry production expenses. Sector-level upper-bound statement, not a measured share for an individual farm or a complete cost budget.

chick_supply_update_2025.source: Botswana Government statement to Parliament, reported by DailyNews/BOPA
chick_supply_update_2025.note: National hatchery production and allocation context only. Does not establish a farm's chick purchase price, survival, growth rate or selling price.

country_data.source: Provisional Algeria broiler planning model: ProfitPilot Algeria poultry simulator (updated 2026-09-26); ONAB–FNA agreement (January 2026); TSA report on producer costs/prices (December 2025).
country_data.cost_source: Estimated cost range of DZD250–280/kg live weight reported by Algerian poultry farmers at end-2025, converted at a 2.5 kg live sale weight to DZD625–700 per bird. Expected cost DZD662.50/bird is the midpoint, not an audited farm budget.
country_data.cost_breakdown_source: Modelled decomposition using a DZD140 day-old chick reference and 5 kg feed per 2.5 kg live bird at DZD8,000/quintal; the DZD122.50 balance is an estimated allowance for veterinary, heating, litter, energy and labour. This breakdown is not a published farm account.
country_data.chick_price_source: ProfitPilot Algeria poultry profitability simulator, hatchery listings recorded 23 September 2026.
country_data.price_source: Low: DZD200/kg producer-gate price reported at end-2025; expected: DZD280/kg ONAB contract price (January 2026); high: DZD410/kg upper wholesale reference recorded September 2026. The upper value is a wholesale-market reference, not a farmgate quote.
country_data.yield_source: ENSA Algiers broiler trial reference reproduced by ProfitPilot: approximately 2.5 kg live weight at seven weeks. Used as the planning output per bird, not a guaranteed farm result.
country_data.survival_rate_source: ProfitPilot summary of Algerian well-managed farm mortality benchmarks: 3–6.5%; 95% survival is a rounded planning assumption.
country_data.scenario_method_note: This is a provisional, locally grounded planning scenario, not a fully verified farm budget. The cost range is derived from reported DZD250–280/kg live production cost multiplied by 2.5 kg. The cost breakdown is a transparent modelled allocation. Selling-price scenarios span different channels and periods: historical producer-gate, ONAB contract, and September 2026 wholesale; compare like-for-like channels before making investment decisions. Do not mark Algeria calculator-ready on this profile alone.
